text: {"lessons":["Set position-size and risk limits before buying; holding through several consecutive declines without a reassessment can let losses grow unchecked.","Review each holding regularly against its fundamentals, recent price action, and the overall market; doing nothing should be a deliberate choice, not neglect.","Track results against a market benchmark and a clear long-term plan, and change course only when evidence supports it rather than reacting to short-term swings."]}
